revision_candidate.test_name: Read and Validate SMBIOS Type 46 String Properties
revision_candidate.purpose: Acquire every SMBIOS Type 46 structure and compare its handle, parent association, property ID and string value with the signed platform reference.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: OS with privileged read access to SMBIOS/DMI data and firmware whose SMBIOS version supports the requested structure.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All Type 46 records returned for the current boot/firmware/configuration; do not substitute Type 11 or arbitrary string search.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: For PASS: SPEC revision, expected Type 46 records/associations/values and comparison rules. These are not required to capture Actual.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Record platform/BIOS/SMBIOS identity, run `dmidecode --type 46` read-only with raw output/status, parse every complete record and compare only if a signed reference is present.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Authorized read privilege and dmidecode available; no firmware change needed.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Exact command/version/status/time; complete unfiltered Type 46 output; parsed handles, parent handles, property IDs/strings; platform/BIOS identity; reference revision and field diff if available.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: All required fields and associations exactly follow the signed reference. Without it, result is Actual Collected / Acceptance Pending, never PASS.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not alter SMBIOS/firmware, guess strings, filter away records or claim absence solely from an unsupported old dmidecode version.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: None for authorized read-only collection; owner provides/approves SPEC for disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Engineer judges undocumented vendor strings or reference applicability.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: None beyond preserving raw output; on access/tool failure, record it and stop.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unsupported tool/table access, truncated output or mismatched platform identity; these stop comparison, not safe inventory.

identified_defects: V2 conflates missing Expected with inability to collect Actual.
reason_for_change: The command is a pure firmware-table read; no SPEC is needed to acquire and preserve Actual values, although PASS still requires the missing reference.
removed_ambiguities: Actual collection and final disposition are separate.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 safely releases read-only evidence collection while retaining the exact no-reference/no-PASS rule, eliminating a canonical over-BLOCKED error.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently separated complete read-only Actual collection from SPEC-dependent PASS, retained every Type 46 handle/association/property/string, and prohibited firmware changes or unsupported-decoder false absence.
